title: Talarico Insider: Texas’s ‘Perfect Storm’ Could Defeat Republican Ken Paxton
author: John Harwood
content:
The Texas Senate race isn't supposed to be this close. Republicans have
controlled the state for more than three decades, and no one makes
conservatives [freak
out](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DalipDxyLPa/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsi=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ==)
more than Democrat James Talarico - but he's [neck-and-
neck](https://thetexan.news/elections/2026/new-poll-shows-texans-split-on-
paxton-and-talarico-opposed-to-flock-and-data-
centers/article_45a2d21c-9c79-417e-b724-6070cfd03887.html) with
[problematic](https://zeteo.com/p/5-reasons-why-ken-paxton-is-the-epitome-
maga-crookedness) Republican Ken Paxton. So what's changed?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Talarico strategist **Chuck Rocha** joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood** to unpack
the forces shaping one of 2026's most surprising, pivotal Senate races -
including data centers, Paxton's unlikability, Talarico's Christian faith,
Latino voters, and gas and grocery prices.

Watch the**full conversation above** for Rocha's inside take on what he calls
a **" perfect storm"** for Talarico and what the Democrat needs to do over the
coming weeks to win.
